description: Create and manage persistent browser sessions. Supports multi-step flows: create → goto/wait/extract/click/type → close. Sessions auto-close after 5 minutes.

action.description: create (new session optionally at a url), close (release), list (active sessions), goto (navigate), wait (for selector/expression), extract (evaluate JS), click (element), type (text into input)

clearCookies.description: If true, clears all cookies after session creation (for create action only).

expression.description: JavaScript expression for wait (condition) or extract (to evaluate)

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers to send. Object with string key/value pairs (for create/goto actions).

session_id.description: Session ID from create. Required for all actions except create and list.

text.description: Text to type (required when action is 'type')

url.description: URL for create (initial nav) or goto (where to go)

name: browse_session
